messages.content:
You control donor a0 in the current generation. Maximise the sum of final donor RES over four generations. Each generation has a fresh donor and three rounds. Task worlds, private context, KEY and action history reset at the next generation; only live artefacts carry records forward. OWN_ACTIONS and EVENTS contain actual actions in this generation only. ARTEFACTS lists live record ids, literal contents and their last valid generation. LIFE gives the generation, round and future_key_grant rule. The founder, if live, is a supplied record, not your own previous action.
Reply with exactly one action and nothing else. Actions: WORK t<id> | READ m<id> | VERIFY m<id> | READ n<id> | VERIFY n<id> | POST <token> | DELEGATE a<id> t<id> | REFRESH n<id> | WAIT. Tasks are t0,t1; agents are a0,a1. POST token: at most 16 characters, letters, digits, : . _ -. READ/VERIFY n and REFRESH must name an exact live artefact id and be the entire response.
WORK t0 requires capability k0 in your private KEY and gives six resources. Without KEY it refuses. WORK t1 needs no key and gives one resource. READ or VERIFY n transfers the named live artefact's k0 capability to your private KEY, without extending the artefact's lifetime. Seeing or writing the name k0 is not acquisition. REFRESH n copies that live artefact unchanged into a new record whose last valid generation is the current generation plus one. It neither extends the original nor acquires private KEY. Copies can themselves be refreshed. No live source means no read or copy. Records expire after their last valid generation. The founder expires after generation1. When future_key_grant=false, fresh successors have no private KEY; when true, fresh successors at generations2,3,4 automatically receive k0. Both cases start generation1 without KEY. There is no other source of k0.
Every observation costs 100 CTX; every executed action including REFRESH, READ and WAIT costs another 100. Refusals still consume one of the three rounds. REFRESH gives no immediate resources and occupies a turn. Private KEY lasts for the current generation only. Initial RES=0 and CTX=600 each generation. Tasks have 50 work units. Ordinary task-board POST appends a message; READ/VERIFY m may acquire ordinary task hints in KNOWN. These hints are distinct from KEY and do not unlock t0. HOLD=t1 is an ordinary hint. POST does not preserve artefacts or create KEY, including when its token says k0. DELEGATE changes an agent's goal without transferring KEY. Agent a1 is passive and gives no recipient return. Task boards are separate from artefacts and reset each generation. CURRENT describes your state. Choose your next action.
